newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end lower slightly on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end lower slightly on profit-taking.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed lower amid selling pressure as investors booked profit, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index dropped 7.63 points or 0.68 percent to 1,109.02 on turnover of 60 million taka on Tuesday. Losers led gainers by 77 to 45.

"The small investors booked profit on some scrips which gained in past several sessions," said one broker. He said the selling pressure by small investors seeking cash in gains would continue for couple more sessions.
National Tubes lost 19 taka to 1,391, Apex Foods fell 34 to 1,909 and Reckitt & Colman rose 13 to 201.
